task: Create and install a local-only Codex CLI fork for dynamic oMLX models

constraint.statement: Prove native harness behavior and a zero-OpenAI runtime boundary on the installed candidate

requirements.requirement: Fork current Codex source while preserving upstream history and provide a separate installed command.
requirements.command: git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD; local-codex --version; codex --version
evidence: The omlx-only branch descends from upstream d583e73c; stock codex remains 0.154.0 and local-codex is separately installed.
requirements.diagnostic_route: Git identity and installed binary hashes

requirements.requirement: Discover the active oMLX coding model without hardcoding a model slug.
requirements.command: Query /admin/api/models; run prepare_runtime.py; rg for the live model slug in fork implementation.
evidence: The loaded default and 262144-token context were selected live; implementation contains no Qwen3.8 model slug.
requirements.permitted_write_surface: Fork runtime generator and isolated generated catalog
requirements.diagnostic_route: Live oMLX inventory and catalog inspection

requirements.requirement: Remove OpenAI OAuth and incidental OpenAI network use from the installed runtime.
requirements.command: Run blocked command matrix, non-loopback rejection, auth-state check, and process-scoped lsof during a live task.
evidence: OAuth/cloud/update/app commands are blocked, auth.json is absent, model work used only 127.0.0.1:8000, and doctor made no external connection.
requirements.permitted_write_surface: Fork launcher/config and isolated runtime state
requirements.diagnostic_route: Negative command tests and live socket evidence

requirements.requirement: Make shell, patch, MCP, image, and multi-agent tools operate through oMLX.
requirements.command: Run live installed JSON canaries for each tool family using the loaded Qwen model.
evidence: All five tool families completed; apply_patch now uses an oMLX-compatible function payload.
requirements.permitted_write_surface: Fork tool adapter and disposable live fixtures
requirements.diagnostic_route: Responses SSE tool loops and rollout evidence

requirements.requirement: Prove manual context compaction and context clearing in the real TUI.
requirements.command: Drive /compact and /clear through a PTY and inspect persisted rollouts.
evidence: The compacted thread recalled its codeword; /clear created a new thread with no old codeword.

requirements.requirement: Keep the unnamed persona separate from IRIS and easy to rename.
requirements.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s local-codex/tests -v; inspect persona.toml and generated AGENTS.md.
evidence: The neutral Local Codex placeholder lives in one editable TOML file and explicitly stays separate from IRIS.
requirements.permitted_write_surface: Fork persona template and isolated runtime persona

requirements.requirement: Build, install, test, commit, push, and pass both closeout gates.
requirements.command: Run scoped Rust/Python tests, release build/install, git checks, MLX closeout, work-closeout, commit, and push.
evidence: Owned tests and live acceptance pass; the sole broader failure reproduces on clean upstream.
requirements.permitted_write_surface: Fork repository and user-owned GitHub fork
requirements.diagnostic_route: Test logs, installed artifact hash, gate outputs, and Git remote state

uncertainty: A second coding model was not loaded; switch behavior is covered by discovery tests and absence of a compiled model slug.
OpenAI-hosted app and curated-plugin tools are intentionally unavailable because local-only takes precedence.
rejected_alternatives: A stock config-only wrapper retained fallback model metadata and background OpenAI plugin sync.
Keeping freeform apply_patch failed because oMLX drops custom tool types.
